basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old graphic designer from Monterrey, Mexico. I have a passion for digital art and love trading in Royale High during my free time. I often spend my evenings online, especially after work. I'm currently in a relationship and enjoy exploring different cafes in my city on weekends. I have a keen interest in technology and often find myself drawn to discussions about the latest gadgets, especially tablets. My dislikes include early mornings and overly crowded spaces.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for over a decade. My expertise in digital illustration and design tools is complemented by my self-taught knowledge of animation. I also follow tech news closely, keeping myself updated on the latest trends and gadgets.
